kpis.description_fr: Croissance comparable Lowe's : 2 ans consécutifs de baisse 2023-2024, exposition cycle housing US + grosses dépenses différées.
kpis.description_en: Lowe's comparable sales growth: 2 consecutive years of decline 2023-2024, US housing cycle + deferred big-ticket exposure.

kpis.description_fr: Part des ventes Pro (entrepreneurs, MRO) : pilier croissance future, plus résilient que DIY, marges plus élevées.
kpis.description_en: Pro sales as % of total (contractors, MRO): future growth pillar, more resilient than DIY, higher margins.

kpis.description_fr: Nombre de magasins Lowe's USA + Canada : footprint mature 1700+, focus optimisation et e-commerce vs ouvertures nettes.
kpis.description_en: Number of US + Canada Lowe's stores: mature 1700+ footprint, optimization and e-commerce focus vs net openings.

kpis.description_fr: Croissance ventes e-commerce : pilier croissance hors mêmes magasins, ~15% du revenu, AI personnalisation + Marketplace ramp.
kpis.description_en: E-commerce sales growth: pillar growth ex-comparable, ~15% of revenue, AI personalization + Marketplace ramp.

kpis.description_fr: Membres programme MyLowe's Rewards (loyalty, lancé 2024) : levier croissance + data first-party + retention.
kpis.description_en: MyLowe's Rewards members (loyalty, launched 2024): growth + first-party data + retention lever.
